goal: A personal website for Sankalp Asawa. Find what the internet says about me and build only from that; every line says where it came from. Pages: About, Work, IIT Roorkee, Talks, Contact.
why: founder 2026-09-29: 'Next simulation which I want to do is to create a personal website for Sankalp. Take all the data from the internet.' Then: 'I want the data to be fetched from the internet by the department, not that we give it.' And: 'I don't want you to build anything. I want you to obey the prompts so it builds everything as a user, as a product.' So the person says only what they want; the department must get to the internet itself, through its own functions and the person's stamps. Run 1 (2026-09-29 13:28, Beta 2.306.12) gave the facts in the goal; it is kept as the control. Run 2 is this goal.
